name: Loom & Lane

tokens.name: surface-100
tokens.usage: Page and chat panel background, like good paper. Also the text colour on indigo fills (9.9:1).

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Assistant message bubbles, inputs and cards that sit on surface-100.

tokens.name: sand
tokens.usage: Decorative dividers and the stitched rule only. Never the only border of a control (fails 3:1).

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Input and control borders on surface-100 and surface-raised (3.5:1).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headings and body text on surface-100 and surface-raised. Softer than black.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Timestamps, hints and taglines on surface-100 and surface-raised (5.5:1).

tokens.name: indigo
tokens.usage: Primary identity colour, after adire cloth. Customer message bubbles, the chat header band and primary buttons, with surface-100 text.

tokens.name: indigo-tint
tokens.usage: Suggested question chips and the adire pattern's relief. Text on it is ink.

tokens.name: clay
tokens.usage: Warm accent: the launcher button, links and highlights. surface-100 text on it holds 5.2:1.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Error text and icons on surface-100 (6.6:1). Always paired with words, never colour alone.
